rules.discovery: the main analysis: P against its pre-specified threshold (GWAS 5e-8, suggestive 1e-5; genes Bonferroni; HLA residues GEC); a reading, never a flag
rules.depth: read down-sampling of the down-sampled cases: flag if the replicate-median |z| is more than 1 below the original |z| (z from the two-sided P)
rules.platform_Q: heterogeneity across the four case platforms (shared controls): flag if the empirical P of Q < 0.05 / number of SAIGE signals; applied at MAF >= 5% only
rules.platform_RE: random-effects estimate (REML, Hartung-Knapp) on the other side of the null from the pooled one; applied at MAF >= 5% only (as Q: SAIGE's one-step stratum beta is unreliable in small strata)
rules.lopo: leave one case platform out: flag if a left-out platform has |z expected| >= 2.8 (z expected = pooled beta / SE without it) and |z observed| < 1.96 or the opposite sign; genes: the CMC burden beta
rules.array: SNP arrays (DNBSeq-T7 cases, HiSeq X controls): flag if the opposite direction or |z WGS - z array| > 3, in any cohort; the array P is not required; genes reported, never flagged
rules.sources_Q: heterogeneity across the five control sources (shared cases): flag if the analytic (chi-square) P of Q < 0.05 / number of SAIGE signals; applied at MAF >= 5% only
rules.sources_loo: leave one control source out: as lopo

design_threats.evidence: a re-run that differs from the main analysis
design_threats.path: a difference made by re-processing, read as an artifact (or hiding one)
design_threats.prediction: If the machinery differed, re-running it on the original data would not reproduce the main-analysis results
design_threats.path_short: Differences in software, settings, or inputs between the re-test and the main analysis alter the test statistics
design_threats.pred_short: The unchanged re-test of the original data fails to reproduce the main-analysis results

design_threats.difference: Depth: deep cases 27.1x–34.4x, DNBSeq-T7 cases 17.6x, controls 17.0x
design_threats.path: depth-dependent genotype errors and missing genotypes, mostly rare variants and indels
design_threats.prediction: If depth made the signal, bringing every case platform to the controls’ depth would weaken it
design_threats.path_short: Genotype calls and missing genotypes depend on read depth, which differs between case groups and controls; rare variants and indels are most affected
design_threats.pred_short: The association attenuates when the cases are down-sampled to the controls' depth

design_threats.difference: Calls of one case platform: chemistry, read length
design_threats.path: different calls or missing genotypes in that platform’s cases
design_threats.prediction: If one platform’s calls made it, the signal would sit in that platform’s cases and vanish without them
design_threats.path_short: The chemistry or read length of one case platform alters genotype calls or missing genotypes in its cases
design_threats.pred_short: The effect is confined to that platform's cases and is lost when they are excluded

design_threats.short: DNBSeq-T7 genotyping error relative to HiSeq X
design_threats.difference: DNBSeq-T7: 319 of 439 cases (F), 100-bp reads against 151 bp on HiSeq X
design_threats.path: DNBSeq-T7 calls differently from HiSeq X; with most cases on it, leaving it out keeps enough cases for strong signals only
design_threats.prediction: If DNBSeq-T7 calls made it, the same people on SNP arrays would not show the association
design_threats.path_short: DNBSeq-T7 differs from HiSeq X in chemistry and read length and carries most cases, so excluding it leaves enough cases for strong signals only
design_threats.pred_short: The association weakens or reverses when the same people are genotyped on SNP arrays

design_threats.difference: HLA alleles typed from the reads
design_threats.path: a depth- or platform-dependent typing error: a false allele or residue
design_threats.prediction: If typing error made the HLA signal, re-typing at the controls' depth would move it and an array-based prediction would disagree
design_threats.path_short: Read-based HLA typing depends on depth and chemistry; a typing error misassigns an allele or residue
design_threats.pred_short: The HLA association moves at the controls' depth, or an array-based typing does not show it

design_threats.path: a batch or population difference of one source carries a signal
design_threats.prediction: If one control source made it, that source would stand out and leaving it out would break the signal
design_threats.path_short: A batch effect or population difference in one of the five control sources shifts control allele frequencies
design_threats.pred_short: That source's estimate departs from the others, and the association disappears when it is excluded

checks.title: Discovery
checks.artifact: none: the main analysis' own reading, shown beside the checks
checks.readout: P of the ORIGINAL arm (= the published result, gates G1-G4; `*_original` columns) against its threshold
checks.rule: the main analysis: P against its pre-specified threshold (GWAS 5e-8, suggestive 1e-5; genes Bonferroni; HLA residues GEC; positions Bonferroni); a reading, never a flag

checks.title: Read down-sampling
checks.artifact: read depth: every case platform but DNBseq-G400RS 15x against controls sequenced at 15x
checks.samples: the 408 down-sampled cases at the controls' median depth (89 NovaSeq and DNBSeq-G400RS 30x cases each to it; 319 DNBSeq-T7 cases by one platform fraction), R = 3 replicates; three cohorts
checks.readout: replicate-median |z| against the original |z|; replicates significant
checks.rule: read down-sampling of the down-sampled cases: flag if the replicate-median |z| is more than 1 below the original |z| (z from the two-sided P)

checks.title: Platform heterogeneity
checks.artifact: a call artifact of one case platform
checks.samples: each case platform's cases against all controls (shared); three cohorts
checks.readout: Q across the four case platforms, its P against null SNPs of the same MAF bin, I²
checks.rule: heterogeneity across the four case platforms (shared controls): flag if the empirical P of Q < 0.05 / number of SAIGE signals; applied at MAF >= 5% only

checks.title: Random effects across platforms
checks.artifact: an effect carried by some case platforms only
checks.readout: random-effects OR (REML, Hartung-Knapp) against the pooled OR
checks.rule: random-effects estimate (REML, Hartung-Knapp) on the other side of the null from the pooled one; applied at MAF >= 5% only (as Q: SAIGE's one-step stratum beta is unreliable in small strata)

checks.title: Leave one platform out
checks.artifact: a signal carried by one case platform
checks.samples: all cases but one platform's, all controls; three cohorts
checks.readout: z observed without each platform against z expected = pooled β / SE without it
checks.rule: leave one case platform out: flag if a left-out platform has |z expected| >= 2.8 (z expected = pooled beta / SE without it) and |z observed| < 1.96 or the opposite sign; genes: the CMC burden beta

checks.title: SNP arrays
checks.artifact: a WGS calling error (a second technology in the same people)
checks.samples: the unrelated genomes with arrays, DNBSeq-T7 cases and HiSeq X controls: narrow 1,398, intermediate 1,460, full 1,683; three cohorts
checks.readout: one marker per signal: the lead typed, else imputed (R2 >= 0.8; DQB1:57:V with HIBAG), else an LD proxy (r2 >= 0.8); its association re-run in the same people against WGS; check/array_crosscheck re-run per cohort (gate G10). Genes: the WGS case carriers of each driver confirmed on the imputed arrays (dosage >= 0.5), counted once in full mainland, which contains the other two cohorts; a description, no rule
checks.rule: SNP arrays (DNBSeq-T7 cases, HiSeq X controls): flag if the opposite direction or |z WGS - z array| > 3, in any cohort; the array P is not required; genes reported, never flagged

checks.title: Control-source heterogeneity
checks.artifact: a control-source batch or population difference
checks.samples: every case against each control source's controls (5 sources); three cohorts
checks.readout: Q across the five sources (shared cases), P, I²
checks.rule: heterogeneity across the five control sources (shared cases): flag if the analytic (chi-square) P of Q < 0.05 / number of SAIGE signals; applied at MAF >= 5% only

checks.title: Leave one control source out
checks.artifact: a signal carried by one control source
checks.samples: every case against all sources but one; three cohorts
checks.readout: z observed without each source against z expected
checks.rule: leave one control source out: as lopo

gates.what: SAIGE step 2 on the ORIGINAL genotypes reproduces assoc_saige's saige.assoc.tsv
gates.rule: every row present; relative difference <= 1e-6 in every compared column

gates.what: rvtest on the ORIGINAL genotypes reproduces the published gene P, OR and carriers
the hla.typing.v2 wrapper reproduces the six 06.assoc_inputs matrices
the HLA re-test reproduces assoc_all.tsv and the residue-position omnibus
the pooled null re-fit reproduces the published null model
gates.rule: variance ratio and median z within 1 %

gates.what: re-processing fidelity: baseline, re-genotyped original GVCFs and original agree
gates.rule: concordance >= 99.5 %, call rate within 0.5 percentage points

gates.what: the swap leaves every genome but the deep cases' byte-identical
achieved depth: depth after / (f x depth before) over the calling intervals
HLA re-typing at f = 1 reproduces the archived typing
the array comparison re-run in full mainland reproduces check/array_crosscheck's tables
gates.rule: same rows and text; numbers within 1e-6 relative

readings.consistent: the check agrees with the signal (arrays: same direction and |z WGS - z array| <= 3)
readings.flag: the check disagrees; flags, never removes
readings.not applicable: the check does not apply (Q and random effects at MAF < 5 %; per-stratum estimates of genes)
readings.reported: a number without a rule (the residue position; the case carriers of a gene's drivers confirmed on the imputed arrays: one cell for the three cohorts, counted in full mainland, which contains the other two)
readings.not checkable: arrays: not typed, not imputed with R2 >= 0.8, no LD proxy with r2 >= 0.8 (genes: no driver in the imputed arrays)
